channel.title: SandboxSim
channel.description: SandboxSim updates, read by Sparkle in the app. tools/publish-release.sh in the app's repository adds the items.

item.description:
SandboxSim 0.17

  • 模板在后台更新时显示进度；新建虚拟机等模板更新时，也能看到进度。
  • 以后更新 SandboxSim，模板和已有的虚拟机不必每次都重新准备。装上 0.17 后还会最后准备一次。
  • 内部改进。

SandboxSim 0.17 (English)

  • The template shows its progress while it updates in the background, and so does a new virtual machine waiting for it.
  • Later updates of SandboxSim no longer prepare the template and existing virtual machines again each time. After installing 0.17 they are prepared once more.
  • Internal improvements.
